title: Provenance of the local sample documents (samples/provenance.json)
description: One row per file in the local, never-committed samples/ folder (docs/evaluation/sample-review.md). The file itself stays on the machine; only this schema is committed. A source whose status stays 'unknown' is not usable outside this machine, which is already the rule for the whole folder.

role.description: original: a downloaded loss run; reference: a downloaded document that is not a loss run (RFP, manual, valuation); intermediate: derived from an original before redaction (e.g. rasterized); redacted: a redacted copy; demo-copy: byte-identical copy of a redacted file staged for a demo; synthetic: made, not downloaded.

use.description: local-testing: may be used for local extraction tests (never committed, never uploaded); reference-only: vocabulary and value ranges; do-not-use: kept for lineage, not for tests (e.g. an unredacted original).

derivedFrom.description: Path (relative to samples/) of the file this one was made from.

status.description: recorded: URL known; named: publisher known, URL not recorded; unknown: neither.

publisher.description: The public body or vendor that published the document.

basis.description: Why the document may be held: a public body's own published record, a vendor's published sample, an open-data release.

method.description: excerpt: pages copied as they are (brief 22: a guide's sample-report pages); excerpt-and-rasterize: pages copied and rendered to images.

history.description: Earlier runs that produced this file's content (a re-run on a redacted copy keeps the first run's work).
